v_bus_line_node_identity.wired_to: dc_bus.line, the FULL DC bus (elec/src/main.ato: safety.dc_bus.line ~ dc_bus.line)
v_bus_line_node_identity.resolution_note: RESOLVED 2026-07-26: the divider senses the full bus, not a half-bus requiring a x2 doubling assumption. An earlier revision of this harness carried a stale half-bus/doubling narrative left over from when main.ato's own comments contradicted each other; see docs/hardware/PROTECTION_CHAIN_REVIEW.md for the resolution history.

verdict.propagation_delay_reason: TLV3201_ngspice.lib declares no timing model; a measured delay from this model would be a modelling artifact, not physical.
verdict.summary: Simulated OVP-01 trip point at the v_bus.line node is 399.96 V and release point is 385.20 V (uncalibrated), giving 14.76 V of hysteresis. This is WITHIN the OVP-01 390-410V trip / 10-20V hysteresis requirement (FUNCTIONAL_TEST_CRITERIA.md SS2.2), matching the OVPComparator module's own inline hand-derivation (399.8V trip, 385.0V release) to within 0.11 V / 0.18 V.
